title: Zero-constant formal substitution is an algebra homomorphism
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $G\in R[[T]]$ have constant coefficient zero [def-weil-formal-power-series]. For $F=\sum_{n\ge0}f_nT^n$ set $S_G(F)=\sum_{n\ge0}f_nG^n$, with each coefficient interpreted as a finite sum. Then $S_G:R[[T]]\to R[[T]]$ is an $R$-algebra homomorphism and $S_G(T)=G$. In particular it fixes constant series and preserves sums, differences and products.
